title: Clothing change (synthetic, SFW)
premise: Before a formal dinner with the harbor master, Mara changes outfits in her quarters while Sable talks logistics. Tests whether who-wears-what stays consistent after changes.
gemini_notes: Everyday, wholesome and non-revealing. Mara changes OUTER clothing only, off-screen detail not required. No undressing descriptions.

R001.name: Captain's Quarters
R001.description: A small tidy cabin with a bunk, a fold-down desk, and a locker that never quite closes. Rain taps the porthole.

turns.speech: Come in, Sable. I'm just getting ready.

{S} {v:tug} at the zip of the jacket, worn soft at the cuffs.
{S} {v:glance} at the dress uniform hanging stiffly on the locker door.

{S} {v:set} the cap on the desk beside the folded orders.

{S} {v:set} the cap crown-down so it {t:would not|will not} roll.
{S} {v:fold} the orders once more and {v:press} them flat.

{S} {v:pull} the hood forward and {v:check} {P} reflection in the porthole.

{S} {v:feel} the heavy wool settle over the uniform's stiff collar.
{S} {v:tilt} {P} head to listen to the rain drumming louder.

turns.sense: {S} {v:feel} the weight of the cloak settle on {P} shoulders.
turns.speech: I promise I'll be back aboard before midnight, whatever the harbor master says.

{S} {v:watch} the lamp sway slightly with the ship.

turns.speech: What am I wearing right now, in case the harbor master asks?

{S} {v:scan} the desk and {v:spot} the cream envelope under the lamp.
{S} {v:sigh} at {R} and {v:fish} it out.

{S} {v:feel} the cloak's weight swing with each step.
{S} {v:let} the cabin door sigh shut behind {O}.

{S} {v:roll} {P} neck and {v:feel} the unfamiliar stiffness of good cloth.
